name: Deadly Opportunist (Combat)
body:
Your opportunity attacks are deadly accurate.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, opportunist rogue talent.

Benefit(s): You increase the critical threat range of any light weapon you wield by 1 when you are making attacks of opportunity. In addition, when you confirm a critical hit with a slight weapon when making an attack of opportunity, you can make an additional attack with the same weapon against the same target as an immediate action.
